order: Newest and biggest first. The most capable model leads, and where capability doesn't settle it, newer goes before older.
updateRule: Add a model in the pull request that first needs it: when it's released, or when it first appears in a tag. Place it by its maker's own ranking where there is one, and above older models of the same tier. Never remove a model, so an old tag still sorts. A model may move, and tags already written aren't rewritten. Set the date above in the same change.
